comment: Shared Go/Python contract for the exact-version lookup key (version.Key in Go, cpe.version_key in Python). key = first two dot-separated segments, each reduced to its leading digits without leading zeros, a missing second segment counting as 0; '' when the version is not usable (ANY, NA, wildcards, no leading digit). Versions that compare equal under the generic and OpenSSH comparators must share a key; rules with key '' are always considered.
